detail.longDescription: Signal's fix for OS AI agents reading your chats is blocking screenshots, and Signal says that doesn't cover an agent reading content off the filesystem. iOS 27: screenshots off in the app by default. Android: Screen Security turns on when an assistant reads the screen, not on every device. macOS: no screenshot block, so add Signal to Excluded Apps in System Settings > Siri. https:// signal.org/blog/protecting-you r-privacy/ # Privacy # Cybersecurity # AIAgents # Signal
